headline: Universal Robina eyes P 8-B capex in 2027, mostly for PH projects
summary: Universal Robina plans up to P8 billion in capital expenditure in 2027, with 80-85% allocated to domestic projects. The spending will expand manufacturing capacity in the Philippines and Southeast Asia.
why: Universal Robina is a major Philippine food and beverage manufacturer, and its capital spending indicates expansion plans and domestic investment.
